[h1]No, Chris. I won’t take a seat over there[/h1]
Noelle Does her Best is an enjoyable game once you get past the protagonist’s… questionable character design. It puts you in the shoes of the titular character who left her town to leave alone and ended up scammed and saddled with a huge debt due to her naivety. She then has to take a variety of jobs that always take a turn for the lewd to get enough money to pay her debt before the deadline, or else who knows what'd happen to her.

While it looks like a "do quests to progress the story" kind of game at first glance, it includes many mechanics that make it better than the average. For starters, doing jobs increases your Job Level and Lewdness stats, which unlock new jobs, and your fatigue, which makes you skip to the next day if it reaches 100. Moreover, some quests require you to kill some monsters in a basic action RPG-like segment where running out of HP increases your fatigue, and nothing pretty happens to the character if it goes over 100 (unless you're into stuff with monsters).

The game's pixel art is great. It looks better than many 2D games, and the animated H-scenes are an added plus. So yeah, check it out if you're into this kind of game and the character's look doesn't put you off; you'll enjoy it.

Gameplay is bare-bones, so don't look here for an authentic RPG experience.  Basically, you go from job to job, which after a while is really go from scene to scene.  Early on there are some fetch quests in one of the three dungeons of the game.  Battle in these dungeons is very basic zelda-like combat.  

If you are worried about the time-constraint - don't be.  The good ending at day 10 is super easy to get, I think you have to go out of your way to not get it.  After the ending, you enter 'extra' mode which just seems to go on forever.  I think I'm on day 26 or something.

I love to pop on this game, see two or three scenes, do my thing, and move on.  It's really great.  Plus there is a rememberance room to see old scenes.

Highly recommend if you want easy access to quality pixel-art scenes.  Plus Noelle is so cute and sexy!

Noelle Does Her Best is the most absurd game I have ever played. Granted, some level of absurdism is a given in mature contents; absence of STD and pregnancy is a common trope repeatedly found in mature contents for a good reason. However, Noelle Does Her Best takes the absurdism to a whole other level and has removed all senses of realism from its writing entirely. In a way, it is the best example you can find for what happens when society loses all senses of reason and decency; all indecent behaviors are practically forgiven and not punished properly, resulting in utter chaos where everyone is happy but destined for corruption. Overall, this game reminded me of the quote: "The road to hell is paved with good intentions, and the road to heaven is paved with good works".

Now, would I recommend this game to someone else? It's a tough question. If you are someone who actively looks out for depictions of uncontrolled indulgence 'above all else', then you might find this enjoyable. But if you expect some level of reason and decency to be present in your mature contents, it's a tough pill to swallow. Plus, this game's developers invested practically everything they had into the pixel art animations, and nothing into the gameplay. So even the biggest fans of this game's pixel art animations might have tough time to enjoy this as a game, since it feels more like a pixel art animation gallery than a game. Therefore, I'd not recommend this game to others unless they are willing to accept absolutely anything and everything as long as they can get top-tier pixel art animations.
